name: Yandex News Feed
author: Mikhail Aivazian

sections.description:
Yandex News Feed is a WordPress plugin that automatically generates an RSS feed for the Yandex “Latest and most important news” program. The plugin creates a valid RSS 2.0 feed with the necessary Yandex extensions and guarantees compliance with all of the search engine’s requirements.

Key Features

  • Automatic Generation: RSS feed created at /feed/yandex-news
  • Full Compliance: Meets all Yandex requirements for news feeds
  • Easy Setup: Simple configuration interface in the WordPress admin panel
  • Flexible Content: Select specific categories and tags to include
  • Customization: Settings for post limits, language, and genre
  • Content Cleaning: Automatic removal of ads and scripts
  • Validation: Built-in feed validation and compliance checking
  • Media Support: Includes images and media content via media:group
  • Exclusions: Option to exclude specific posts manually
  • Performance: Caching enabled for optimization

Yandex Requirements

The plugin automatically ensures compliance with the following requirements:

  • RSS 2.0 format with Yandex extensions
  • Mandatory fields: title, link, pubDate, yandex:full-text
  • Feed size no larger than 10 MB
  • UTF-8 encoding
  • No advertising in the content
  • Accessible without authorization

Integration with Yandex Webmaster

  1. Log in to Yandex Webmaster.
  2. Go to Publisher Center → Latest and most important news.
  3. Click Upload feed and paste your feed URL.
  4. Wait for the feed validation (this may take several days).

Supported Languages

  • Russian (ru)
  • English (en)
  • Turkish (tr)

Compatibility

The plugin is compatible with:
* WordPress 5.0+
* PHP 7.4+
* Popular caching plugins
* Multilingual sites
* Any WordPress theme

Support

For support:
* Create an issue in the GitHub repository
* Contact Yandex Webmaster

Privacy Policy

The plugin does not collect or transmit user personal data. All settings are stored locally in the WordPress database.

Credits

Developed by the Yandex team to simplify the integration of news sites with the Yandex search engine.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  3. Search for “Yandex News Feed”.
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin archive.
  2. Unzip it into the /wp-content/plugins/ folder.
  3. Activate the plugin in the admin panel.

Configuration

  1. Go to Settings → Yandex News Feed.
  2. Select categories to include in the feed.
  3. Configure the feed parameters.
  4. Copy the feed URL to add to Yandex Webmaster.
sections.faq:
What is my RSS feed URL?

After activating the plugin, your feed will be available at: https://example.com/feed/yandex-news

How do I add the feed to Yandex Webmaster?

  1. Log in to Yandex Webmaster.
  2. Add your site and verify ownership rights.
  3. Go to Publisher Center → Latest and most important news.
  4. Click Upload feed and paste the URL.

Can I exclude individual posts?

Yes, there is an option labeled “Exclude from Yandex News Feed” inside the post editor.

How often is the feed updated?

The feed updates automatically when new posts are published. The cache is automatically cleared every 5 minutes.

Does the plugin support images?

Yes, the plugin automatically includes post images in the feed using media:group tags.
